title: MA access availability, ghost-network, and denied-claim visibility audit
problem: MA denial/appeal/clinical rows can falsely pass when the network is nominal, the provider directory contains inactive providers, behavioral-health access is only counted nominally, or encounter data lacks a definitive denied-claim indicator.
corrections: Added eight locator-bound evidence records, including two contradict records.
Added an access-availability and denied-claim visibility row contract.
Refactored stale current-revision assumptions in prior MA audit scripts.
primary_blocker_after: No current acquired row joins network adequacy, directory accuracy, active provider/appointment availability, definitive denied-claim status, clinical correctness, and restoration.
